metadata.body:
Collect JAX-RS and Vaadin telemetry separately for the default controller-disabled profile and `otel.instrumentation.common.controller-telemetry.enabled=true`. Label JAX-RS experimental profiles with both enabled settings, while retaining enabled and disabled behavior coverage.

Controller-only split of #20552 for #20546, based on #20564.

The extracted source currently has failing default-off JAX-RS assertions and Vaadin test compilation errors. This PR preserves them rather than mixing fixes into the split.
